name: Seacoast United Youth Soccer Camps
description_short: Soccer camps run by Seacoast United Soccer Club's coaching staff at several locations in Massachusetts, Maine and New Hampshire. Programs include Grassroots (ages 3-6), Summer Skills (6-14), Advanced Training (7-15), Goalkeeper and Residential camps.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds. All registration fees are non-refundable for any reason, including program cancellation, injury, absence or non-participation. Families who withdraw after the season starts still owe any remaining payments.

warnings: This is an overview page for several camp programs. It lists no season, dates, prices or bookable sessions, so season_year is left empty.
The page covers several camp formats, including residential (overnight) camps and what look like day camps. camp_type is set to specialty because every program is soccer only.
The address shown is the club's P.O. Box mailing address in Hampton, NH. Camps are held at several locations in MA, ME and NH.
The residential camp ages conflict: the heading says 9-18 years, but the text says U7 to U18.
The goalkeeper camps are labeled 'all ages' but described as for U9 to U19.
unknowns: Registration URL and registration opening date

Exact age range for residential camps (header says 9-18, text says U7 to U18)
